title: Max in the School Garden
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for the McKinley Bulldogs.

pages: Max's class has a planter box in the McKinley garden. Today they are planting seeds.
Max digs a tiny hole with one finger. Max drops in a lettuce seed and covers it with soil. Lupe plants carrots, and Kai plants beans.
Then Max finds a wiggly worm. "Eww!" says Kai. "Worms are good," says the teacher. "They make tunnels so air and water can get to the roots."
Every day, the class takes turns with the watering can. Max waters very carefully, so the seeds do not wash away.
For a long time, nothing happens. Max checks every morning. "Are you there, lettuce?"
Then one day, Max sees tiny green leaves poking up! The class cheers.
Weeks later, the lettuce is big and crunchy. The class washes it and makes a salad to share.
Max takes a big bite. "This is the best salad in the world," Max says. "Because we grew it ourselves!"
